cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); The Anderson Galleries, New York, NY, auction, lot no. 149, 23 February 1922; Frank Crowninshield, New York, NY, 1922; Parke-Bernet Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, lot no. 220, 20-21 October, 1943; Gypsy Rose Lee, New York, NY, 1943; Descended in family; Marlborough Gallery Inc., New York, NY, before 1973; Harry Spiro, New York, NY, 1973; Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1973 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "I have dated this 1921 as Miss O'Keeffe says it is a companion piece to 'Water Lilies,' which was painted in 1921." See cat. no. 350. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Pond Lilies

description: Three pink waterlilies with green stems sit in a black box. One lily is fully bloomed, another is halfway open, and the third has not yet begun to bloom. The box rests on a gray surface, and plain paper is visible around the edges of the composition.
title: Pond Lilies
